newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Jan-Aug rubber output down 0.7 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Jan-Aug rubber output down 0.7 pct y/y.

text.p: Malaysia's natural rubber production fell 0.7 percent to 699,207 tonnes in the first eight months of 1996 from 704,022 tonnes in the same period last year, the national Bernama news agency said on Friday.
It quoted the Statistics Department as saying that on a month-to-month basis, output fell 3.5 percent to 93,644 tonnes in August this year from 97,073 tonnes in July.
But output was up 4.8 percent in August from August 1995, when 89,341 tonnes were produced.
Export of rubber for the first eight months of this year was mainly to the United States, which consumed 75,274 tonnes, Korea, China, Germany, Britain, Japan and Italy.
